newsitem.title: USA: Superior Services files for 3.75 mln offer.
newsitem.headline: Superior Services files for 3.75 mln offer.

text.p: Superior Services Inc on Tuesday said it registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed public offering of 3.75 million newly issued shares of common stock.
The sale is part of the company's shelf registration for a proposed offering of five million shares, filed with the SEC August 7.
Completion of the offering is expected in mid-September.
Prior to the offering, Superior Services had about 19.3 million common shares outstanding.
Superior Services estimates net proceeds at $85.6 million, based on the stock's closing price of $24.125 on August 18 and assuming the overallotment option given to the underwriters is not exercised.
It said it would use the funds to repay debt and to support a strategy to acquire other solid waste operations, the company said in a statement.
Superior Services provides solid waste services to more than 400,000 residential, commercial and industrial customers in nine states.
Superior Services has granted underwriters of the offering a 30-day option to buy up to 562,500 more shares of common stock to cover overallotments.
Underwriters are led by Alex. Brown & Sons Inc; Goldman, Sachs & Co.; Robert W. Baird & Co. Inc; and Raymond James & Associates Inc.
